units.source_text: 金阁的第一层法水院有两处入口。

en.t: The Ho-sui-in, the first level of the Golden Pavilion, had two entrances.

units.source_text: 东西各一处，都带左右对开的两扇门扉。

en.t: There was one on the east and one on the west, each with a pair of doors that opened to the left and right.

units.source_text: 当向导的老人夜间登上金阁，从里侧将西门关得严严实实，

en.t: At night, when the old guide went up into the Golden Pavilion, he shut the west door tightly from the inside,

units.source_text: 然后又从外侧关上东门，并上了锁。

en.t: then closed the east door from the outside as well and locked it.

units.source_text: 但我知道，即使没有钥匙也能够进人金阁。

en.t: But I knew that even without a key, one could get into the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 从东门绕到后面北边的板门，正好是保护着阁内的金阁模型的背后。

en.t: If one went around from the east door to the wooden door at the rear on the north side, it was just behind the Golden Pavilion model kept inside the building.

units.source_text: 这扇板门已经老朽，上下钉着六七颗钉子，要拔是很容易的。

en.t: This wooden door was already old and decayed, with six or seven nails driven into it at the top and bottom, and they were easy to pull out.

units.source_text: 钉子都已松动，只要用手指的力量就可以轻而易举地把它拔下来。

en.t: The nails had all come loose, and with only the strength of my fingers I could pull them out quite easily.

units.source_text: 我尝试拔了两颗，用纸包好，放到书桌抽屉的最里首保存起来。

en.t: I tried pulling out two of them, wrapped them carefully in paper, and put them away at the very back of my desk drawer.

units.source_text: 数目过去了，似乎谁也没有发觉。

en.t: Several days passed, and it seemed that no one had noticed.

units.source_text: 一周过去了，依然谁也没有发觉。

en.t: A week passed, and still no one had noticed.

units.source_text: 28日晚上，我又悄悄地把那两颗钉子回复原处。

en.t: On the night of the twenty-eighth, I quietly put those two nails back where they had been.
